title: BrainCliResult
description:
What every `brain-toolkit` command prints with `--json` (D143; owner list: ok, deferred, uncertain, error, model, effort, tokens, writes, details). `agent-runner` parses it to decide a job's state; the exit codes are the toolkit's (0 ok, 3 deferred, 1 uncertain or failed).

- `ok: true` means the command did what it was asked: `deferred` and `uncertain` are false and `error` is null.
- `deferred: true` means a usage limit or the daily ceiling stopped an AI call (spec section 7): nothing was done, `ok` is false, the job is retried later. Never an API fallback.
- `uncertain: true` means the command may have partly acted; it is never auto-retried.
- A failure is `ok: false, deferred: false` with a non-empty `error`.
- `model` and `effort` are what the command used (an explicit `--model`/`--effort` override included, never stored); both are `null`, and `tokens` is 0, when no AI call was made (`--dry-run`, `note pin`).
- `writes` lists the repo-relative paths the command wrote (the set `agent-runner` is allowed to land); `details` is the command-specific payload (an open object, `{}` when none).

The `if/then` couplings are enforced by the schema only; the generated TypeScript and Python models treat those members as independent.

error.description: Why the command failed, or null.

tokens.description: Tokens the command's AI calls spent.

writes.description: Repo-relative paths written (forward slashes, no leading slash, no `..`).
